content:
The capital of India is **New Delhi**.

New Delhi is a part of the larger **National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi** and serves as the administrative, political, and diplomatic center of the country. It was officially declared the capital of British India in 1911 and became the capital of independent India in 1947.
